scripts.build:samples: gulp install:samples && npm run build && npm run move:samples && gulp build:samples
scripts.publish: npm run prerelease && npm run build:prod && ./node_modules/.bin/lerna publish --force-publish --exact -m "chore(release): publish %s release"
scripts.publish:beta: npm run prerelease && npm run build:prod && ./node_modules/.bin/lerna publish --npm-tag=beta -m "chore(release): publish %s release"
scripts.publish:next: npm run prerelease && npm run build:prod && ./node_modules/.bin/lerna publish --npm-tag=next --no-git-tag-version --no-push -m "chore(release): publish %s release"
scripts.publish:rc: npm run prerelease && npm run build:prod && ./node_modules/.bin/lerna publish --npm-tag=rc -m "chore(release): publish %s release"
scripts.publish:test: npm run prerelease && npm run build:prod && ./node_modules/.bin/lerna publish --force-publish --npm-tag=test --no-git-tag-version --no-push -m "chore(release): publish %s release"

scripts.prestart: npm run generate:supergraph && npm run generate:typings
scripts.prestart:dev: npm run generate:supergraph && npm run generate:typings
